q.t: How many lines of symmetry does a square have?
q.e: Two through the midpoints of opposite sides and two along the diagonals.

q.t: How many lines of symmetry does a rectangle (not a square) have?
q.e: The two lines through the midpoints of opposite sides. Folding along a diagonal does not match the corners.

q.t: How many lines of symmetry does a circle have?
q.e: Every diameter is a line of symmetry.

q.t: How many lines of symmetry does an equilateral triangle have?
q.e: One from each corner to the middle of the opposite side.

q.t: How many lines of symmetry does an isosceles triangle (not equilateral) have?
q.e: The line down the middle between the two equal sides.

q.t: How many lines of symmetry does the capital letter A have?
q.e: A vertical line down the middle.

q.t: How many lines of symmetry does the capital letter H have?
q.e: One vertical and one horizontal.

q.t: How many lines of symmetry does a scalene triangle have?
q.e: With all sides different, no fold makes the halves match.

q.t: A line of symmetry divides a figure into:
o: Two parts that are mirror images
q.e: Folding along the line makes one half lie exactly on the other.

q.t: How many lines of symmetry does the capital letter M have?
q.e: A vertical line down the middle.

q.t: How many lines of symmetry does a rhombus (not a square) have?
q.e: Its two diagonals.

q.t: How many lines of symmetry does a parallelogram (not a rectangle or rhombus) have?
q.e: No fold makes the slanting halves match.

q.t: How many lines of symmetry does a kite have?
q.e: The diagonal between the two pairs of equal sides.

q.t: How many lines of symmetry does a regular pentagon have?
q.e: A regular polygon has as many lines of symmetry as sides.

q.t: How many lines of symmetry does a regular hexagon have?
q.e: 3 through opposite corners and 3 through the midpoints of opposite sides.

q.t: Which capital letter has NO line of symmetry?
q.e: A and T fold left to right; X folds both ways; F does not match under any fold.

q.t: How many lines of symmetry does the capital letter X have?
q.e: One vertical and one horizontal.

q.t: How many lines of symmetry does a semicircle have?
q.e: The line through the middle of the straight edge, at right angles to it.

q.t: The capital letter B has a line of symmetry that is:
q.e: The top half mirrors the bottom half.

q.t: In a mirror placed beside it, the letter b looks like:
q.e: A side mirror swaps left and right: the loop moves to the other side of the stick.

q.t: How many lines of symmetry does a regular octagon have?
q.e: One for every side.

q.t: How many lines of symmetry does an isosceles trapezium have?
q.e: The line through the midpoints of the two parallel sides.

q.t: How many lines of symmetry does the capital letter Z have?
q.e: Z looks the same after a half-turn, but no fold matches its halves.

q.t: Which shape has exactly 2 lines of symmetry?
q.e: A square has 4, an equilateral triangle 3, a kite 1.

q.t: How many of the capital letters A, B, C, D have a horizontal line of symmetry?
q.e: B, C and D fold top to bottom. A folds left to right only.

q.t: How many of the capital letters A, B, C, D have a vertical line of symmetry?
q.e: Only A.

q.t: How many lines of symmetry does an arrow shape (→) have?
q.e: The line along its shaft.

q.t: Add the lines of symmetry of a square and an equilateral triangle.
A diagonal of a rectangle (not a square) is:
o: A line of symmetry only if drawn in ink
q.e: Fold along it and the corners do not land on each other.

q.t: How many lines of symmetry does a plus sign (+) with equal arms have?
q.e: Vertical, horizontal and the two diagonals.

q.t: How many letters of the word MATHEMATICS (in capitals) have a vertical line of symmetry?
q.e: M, A, T, H, M, A, T and I do. E, C and S do not.

q.t: How many lines of symmetry does a regular polygon with 10 sides have?
q.e: One for each side.

q.t: A clock shows 2 o’clock. What time does it appear to show in a mirror?
q.e: The mirror swaps left and right, so the hour hand at 2 appears at 10. (The two times add up to 12.)

q.t: How many digits from 0 to 9 look the same in a mirror placed beside them (written in simple block style)?
q.e: 0, 1 and 8 are symmetric left to right.

q.t: A figure has exactly 3 lines of symmetry. It could be:
q.e: A square has 4, a rectangle 2 and a circle infinitely many.

q.t: How many letters of the word SCHOOL (in capitals) have at least one line of symmetry?
q.e: C (horizontal), H (both), O and O. S and L have none.

q.t: Add the lines of symmetry of a rectangle, a rhombus and a kite.
A regular polygon has 7 lines of symmetry. How many sides does it have?
q.e: Lines of symmetry = number of sides for a regular polygon.

q.t: Which word (in capitals) looks the same in a mirror placed beside it?
q.e: M and O are symmetric left to right, and the word reads the same backwards. D, B and S are not.

q.t: A square sheet is folded along both diagonals and both lines through the midpoints of its sides. Into how many equal triangles do the folds divide it?
q.e: Four lines through the centre cut the square into 8 identical triangles.
